spots.name: Aurora borealis
spots.blurb: You've reached Aurora borealis, a mural by Lars Englund. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.name: Don’t complain
spots.blurb: You've reached Don’t complain, a mural by Eva Hertov;Moa Krestesen from 2010. Konstverket har sin utgångspunkt i gatukonst och västerbottnisk textiltradition. Teknik: måleri, textil och gravyr i betong.
